summary:
command_centre is CarbonSettle's Next.js 16 + Supabase + Vercel CRM and cold-outbound engine: about 150 API routes, 47 cold-email modules, IMAP inbox with AI intent classification and translation, WhatsApp Business channel, signed personalised /p offer pages with React-PDF briefs, first-party cookieless analytics, team chat with zero-third-party Web Push, and a Capacitor Android/iOS shell that loads the live URL.
There is no RAG or knowledge-graph code; the owner's 'company brain' is a process artefact (AGENT-CONTEXT.md, SESSION-LOG.md, SESSION-LOG-PROTOCOL.md, a local auto-memory graph, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md mirrors).
The engineering is mature; the business is not: 916 cold importer emails produced 2 verified humans and 0 revenue, and the CRM had one lead in a commercial stage with no price ever quoted (STATE-2026-08-24).
Highest-value finding for Taxila: most measured engagement was mail-security sandboxes (~3x inflation). lib/engagement-classifier.ts encodes a measured HUMAN rule (session>=45s, >=2 heartbeats, >8s/heartbeat, >10min after send) with reasons and demote-only extra rules.
That heartbeat-cadence method plus the proposal-analytics tracker (visible-only active time, per-section dwell, scroll, delegated clicks) ports directly to covert attention signals on Forge modules and to parent-report analytics.
Second: an agent-fleet method with measured outcomes: hard-law briefs, a known-domains skip list, central mechanical gating ('nothing an agent wrote was trusted'), seeded adversarial 10% audits escalating to a 100% census at >20% defects, and concurrency <=15.
Shard disagreement (6x), regex over-keep (33-56% junk vs <=10% hand-reviewed) and snippet-as-evidence are measured failure modes.
Reusable infra worth copying: generic Postgres audit trigger with app.actor GUC and rollback recipes; atomic conditional-UPDATE lease; rotation-safe signed links; constant-time compare; AES-256-GCM field encryption; env fingerprint checker; durable email write-ahead when the DB fails; heuristic-first, forced-tool, never-null classifier; VAPID Web Push with pruning.
The context-project-review branch (not merged to main) holds a security sweep at 136/136 tests: signing secret split from password, signed identity cookie, no query-string secrets.
It also found that every unsubscribe link ever sent was broken (token split on '.').
Rejections are plentiful and specific: tags and labels untrusted, licence-before-source, RLS FOR UPDATE silent 0-row writes, a classifier enum out of sync with the DB CHECK, 1000-row truncation, gates only at enroll time, verdict cache drift, duplicated constants, hand-typed prompt facts, the 'Hi Visit Website' name bug, success-on-failure UI, hover-only touch affordances, fabrication requests declined.
Not portable as-is: OpenRouter/Anthropic providers (Azure-only directive), WhatsApp STOP-confirm friction (DPDP), remote-URL Capacitor shell for a store-published kids app, VAPID key in a DB table.

assets.title: HUMAN vs MACHINE session classifier
assets.what: Groups proposal events into sessions, attaches session-less events by time window (counts only, never timings), labels HUMAN/MACHINE with typed reasons (session<45s, <2 heartbeats, <=8s/heartbeat, <=10min after send, click before page_view, ip shared by >=3 unrelated leads, no session). Extra rules may only demote toward MACHINE.
assets.taxila_target: telemetry + covert attention verdicts on Forge modules; parent-report link analytics

assets.title: Behavioural journey tracker
assets.what: Client tracker: session_start/return_visit, page_view once per session, scroll milestones, per-[data-section] dwell via IntersectionObserver, visible-only activeMs, 15s heartbeat, delegated click classes, CustomEvent hooks (cs:calc), session_end summary; batched sendBeacon/keepalive; staff/dev exclusion flag.
assets.taxila_target: module engagement telemetry feeding learner model

assets.title: First-party cookieless analytics collector
assets.what: CORS beacon endpoint; cookieless daily-rotating visitor hash + 30-min session bucket; salted IP hash; GA-style source classification; drops bot UAs and datacenter/scanner AS orgs (IPinfo Lite, cached).
assets.taxila_target: marketing-site analytics without consent banner; DPDP-friendly telemetry
assets.notes: BOT_ORG regex includes microsoft/azure - review before reuse on Azure-hosted product

assets.title: Heuristic-first intent classifier with forced tool schema
assets.what: Tier 1 high-precision phrase heuristics; tier 2 LLM with forced tool_choice (enum intent, confidence 0-1, reasoning<=200); tier 3 never-null best-effort heuristic. Clamps enum/confidence, persists model+confidence, intent->action sets, cron batch over unclassified rows.
assets.evidence: growth-insights-2026-07-24: classifier unreliable (meeting requests in negative) - human glance still required

assets.title: Task-routed LLM client with fallback chain + lenient JSON
assets.what: Plain-fetch client; per-task model chain tried once each with AbortController timeout; any non-OK advances; lenient JSON parse (raw->unfenced->outermost braces); returns which model answered; null instead of throw.
assets.taxila_target: Azure OpenAI deployment/region fallback chain (providers must be swapped to Azure-only)

assets.title: Grounded draft + conversational refine
assets.what: Context block (thread history, profile, engagement, notes) -> first draft at temp 0.35; refine turns carry currentDraft + instruction + priorInstructions to preserve; rules forbid inventing facts.
assets.taxila_target: parent message / weekly-note drafting with teacher-in-loop edits
assets.notes: System prompt is sentence-shaped; Taxila law says write shapes not lines

assets.title: Fail-open ingest translation with multilingual quote stripping
assets.what: HTML->text, strips Gmail/Outlook quote markers in EN/DE/FR/IT/ES/NL and signatures, detects language, stores translation_lang/translated_en/translated_at contract; never blocks ingest.

assets.title: Zero-third-party Web Push (VAPID)
assets.what: Self-generated VAPID keypair, per-user subscriptions, prune 404/410, never-throw senders, service worker with tag/renotify and focus-or-navigate on click, gesture-gated opt-in.
assets.notes: VAPID private key was stored in a DB table and was anon-readable until 2026-07-14; use Key Vault/secret store

assets.title: In-app polling toast + vibration
assets.what: 12s visible-only poll; first sync primes seen-map silently; skips own and new-channel backlog; toast + navigator.vibrate works in Android WebView.

assets.title: Multi-source notification feed with watermark
assets.what: Per-source guarded queries produce {kind,title,detail,at,href}; client last-seen watermark drives badge.

assets.title: Team chat schema + data layer
assets.what: app_users, chat_channels (dm_key sorted unique, entity_kind/entity_id pin), members with last_read_at/muted, messages with attachment/reply_to/soft-delete, reactions, last_message_at trigger, missing-table setup state, entity-pinned channel get-or-create.

assets.title: Generic row-audit trigger with actor GUC + rollback recipes
assets.what: SECURITY DEFINER, empty search_path; full old/new jsonb, changed_fields, db_user, app.actor; skips updated_at-only; RLS no-policy sink; SQL recipes for per-row history and rollback.
assets.taxila_target: learner-model, consent and Conductor audit trail on Neon Postgres
assets.evidence: built after 2026-07-15 pipeline stage-loss scare; forensics found no loss but no trail existed

assets.title: Conditional-UPDATE lease claim
assets.what: UPDATE ... SET next_send_at=now+10m WHERE id AND status IN AND next_send_at<=now RETURNING id; 0 rows = claim lost; partial unique index backstop; slot release on bookkeeping failure.

assets.title: Bearer-auth cron with time window, weekend block, rolling cap
assets.what: CRON_SECRET bearer (constant-time in review branch), IST window/weekend gating, rolling hourly cap re-checked inside loop, randomised batch sizes.
assets.taxila_target: Conductor quiet hours for child/parent notifications; AI cost caps

assets.title: timingSafeEqual helper

assets.title: Signed identity cookie v1:user:sig
assets.what: HMAC-signed username cookie; split on last colon; tampered -> null (re-pick, no lockout).

assets.title: Rotation-safe signed public links
assets.what: base64url(id.type.sig24) HMAC; VALID_TYPES allowlist; new secret signs, verification tries new then legacy so sent links survive rotation.

assets.title: RFC-8058 one-click unsubscribe tokens

assets.taxila_target: DPDP consent-withdrawal links with round-trip tests

assets.title: AES-256-GCM field encryption

assets.taxila_target: field-level encryption of child PII / tokens at rest

measurements.claim: Offer-page engagement ~3x inflated by mail-security sandboxes: 205 page views ~67 real; 149 brief reads ~26 real
Sandbox heartbeats ~1.8s apart vs 15000ms code interval; sessions 0-24s; clicks before page_view
916 cold emails to EU importers -> 2 verified humans -> 0 conversations -> 0 revenue; DE wave 319 sends -> 0 human engagement
Funnel 5,899 emailed -> 208 viewers -> 149 brief readers -> 76 replies (~11 interested) -> 1 trial -> 0 won
Loss-framed subject beat 'free' subject ~2.2x (6.1% vs 2.8% page-view rate)
measurements.method: CRM cohort comparison, timing confound noted

measurements.claim: Send hour: 16:00 IST 6.5% view rate vs 09:00 1.2%; Friday worst
Named contact vs info@: no lift (3.59% vs 3.32% view)
LLM reply classifier mislabels meeting requests as negative; human glance required
eu_strong tag only ~34% reliable (51% wrong-industry, 12% wrong-company)
Interleaved agent shards disagreed 6x on exporter rate; re-verdict precision C3 63% / C1 58% / C4 36% / C2 33%; C2 cited no evidence on 45% of rows
measurements.method: RECON Opus lane against one written standard

measurements.claim: Hand-reviewed lanes <=10% junk vs auto/regex-kept lanes 33-56%
measurements.method: per-lane QA across ~44 agents + 2 adversarial passes

measurements.claim: Names derived from email local-parts: 0/1,876 accented vs 49.6% in registry; only 106 contacts had both name and email
Contact lane fail rates: registry 0%, web_research 93%, spoc_site 83%, spoc_linkedin 63%
Wrong-domain junk 5.75% of 2,296 domains; 156 sends to 87 junk domains = 2.15% of 7,257 sends
Name-domain affinity heuristic over-condemns 4.75x and passes 48% of real junk
Lane N 10% adversarial sample: 33 pass / 10 fail / 1 unverifiable (23%) -> census; evidence host matched own domain 443/443; 0 fabricated emails
measurements.method: seeded stratified sample, 4 auditors + 7 census auditors

measurements.claim: Shared egress 429/502 above ~15 concurrent agent lanes
21 of 30 'unreachable' hosts answered on a plain retry; recovery pass won back 24 of ~110 emails
Unverified MX-only sends bounced ~6%; ELV-verified waves 0-0.3%
Fleet of 18 mailboxes: 0 spam complaints ever; bounce ~1% Aug vs 5.6% July
Capacity spillover lost local time: 29% of July sends landed 04:00-08:00 local
WhatsApp error 131049 silently drops MARKETING templates to cold recipients; inbound-opened 24h window exempt
557 leads had in_scope verdicts never written back to leads.scope_status (invisible to audiences)
Hourly cap declared twice (150 vs 120) -> planner under-booked 25%
~40 tables anon-readable/writable incl. lead PII and VAPID private key; /api/leads returned 200 + 7.4MB unauthenticated
Tests 136/136 (16 files) after review fixes; CI had been red ~07-14 to 07-27 from a stale mock

88 replies all-time: 21 positive, 3 meeting, 8 question, 1 referral; all warm threads India-side

concepts.name: Verify, never assert
concepts.description: Numbers come from the live DB/API in-session; 'verified' only when checked; agents correct their own overstated claims in the log.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent-facing numbers read live at report time

concepts.name: Feedback memory with the WHY
concepts.description: Owner preferences captured immediately as typed memories (user/feedback/project/reference) with reason and how-to-apply, linked by wikilinks; feedback/project are the high-value types agents forget.

concepts.name: Durability over babysitting
concepts.description: Long jobs write cursors/state/commits so dead sessions resume losslessly; fleets swapped between models from on-disk STATE.

concepts.name: Cheap-first, agent-only-for-judgment
concepts.description: Deterministic $0 prefilter condemns only confident junk and never auto-keeps; agents judge cached pages.

concepts.name: Hard-law brief + central gating
concepts.description: Subagents get inviolable laws; an assembler re-checks everything mechanically; adversarial auditors assume fabrication; >20% defect sample escalates to census.

concepts.name: Asymmetric rules
concepts.description: Added rules may only move a verdict toward the safe side (MACHINE), never toward HUMAN.

concepts.name: Soft-delete, never hard-delete
concepts.description: Quarantine flags are reversible; records with outbound links are never deleted.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child records, consent history, report links

concepts.name: Public surface host split
concepts.description: A dedicated public host serves only prospect surfaces; app routes 404 there; sent links public forever.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent-share links on a separate host from the app

concepts.name: Fail-open enrichment, fail-closed safety
concepts.taxila_relevance: Affect signals fail open; safety and consent fail closed

concepts.name: One canonical rule location
concepts.description: Audience rule as one SQL function; limits as one constant; prompt facts from one source.
concepts.taxila_relevance: compile() and contracts as single sources

concepts.name: Contextual chat
concepts.description: Channels pinned to the work record via entity_kind/entity_id.

concepts.name: Trial-to-self before external send
concepts.description: Full chain verified on an internal inbox before any send.

concepts.name: Screenshot before shipping
concepts.description: Headless Chrome at 1440px and 390px; read the PNG; iterate.

concepts.name: Model tiering
concepts.description: Mechanical lanes on cheaper models, judgment/QA on top models; orchestrator verifies/commits/deploys.
